mentions.name: Video game generator from photos
mentions.description: This tool generates playable video games from photos, with a focus on reducing the time needed to produce a finished game down to about two hours. An example first-person shooter built with the tool is available as an online demo.
mentions.problem: The bottleneck of this kind of generator is 'how much time to obtain the video game".
mentions.source_excerpt:
Improving my 'Video game generator from photos'. 
The bottleneck of this kind of generator is 'how much time to obtain the video game".
I managed on my last vacation (it's a side project) to reduced it to 2 hours. 
 This is an example of one FPS made by my tool : 
https://free-visit.net/fr/demo01
